page.overview:
Who is Baby Tyrannosaur?

Female Tyrannosaur (mother) Other siblings|born=c. March 1995|name=250px}}|The Lost World (novel)}}

The baby Tyrannosaur was an infant Tyrannosaurus rex that lived on Isla Sorna. The female and male Tyrannosaurs were its parents. The baby had its leg broken by Howard King, who stepped on it.

The baby Tyrannosaurus lived in the nest made by its parents on Isla Sorna. The baby had just hatched by the time of the 1995 expedition on the island.

Lewis Dodgson, Howard King, and George Baselton were getting eggs from the nest when they ran into the newly hatched baby. Dodgson yelled at King, who was dazed, to get an egg. King grabbed one, which slipped out of his hands. He caught it again, lurching back. He stepped on the baby's left leg, causing it to scream.
